# Describe the user-visible outcome

## Summary

Briefly state the problem and resulting behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- Specify an observable result and the scenario that proves it.

## Scope

Define what this story owns and explicitly deferred work.

## Implementation guidance

Link the slice spec and list relevant code, reuse points, constraints, and suggested implementation sequence.

## Interfaces

Define shared types, request/result shapes, state transitions, errors, and file/contract ownership. If no interface changes are needed, explain what existing contract is preserved.

## Validation

List meaningful scenarios, failure cases, commands and required browser evidence.

## Completion handoff

Report changed files, decisions, acceptance evidence, check results, limitations and follow-ups. Update status to in-review once implementation and evidence are ready.
